name: Soft-World International Corporation
summary: Soft-World International Corporation, along with its affiliated companies, is actively involved in the creation, management, and dissemination of video games across Taiwan and mainland China. The firm provides a comprehensive suite of services, including the MyCard prepaid platform, which facilitates purchases for digital goods and within games. Its core business encompasses the full lifecycle of online and mobile games, from their development and publishing to ongoing operational support. Beyond gaming, Soft-World also manages physical e-PLAY retail outlets, offers expertise in exhibition design and event planning, and delivers cloud computing services. Additionally, its portfolio extends to media solutions, such as digital marketing and advertising campaigns, alongside various payment processing options, including third-party and mobile payment capabilities. Established in 1983, Soft-World International Corporation is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
